license.name: Commercial Installations Inc
license.registry: North Carolina Licensing Board for General Contractors public license search (portal.nclbgc.org/Public/Search)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Company-name searches for 'Commercial Installations' and 'Commercial Install' and a phone search for the company number (919-365-5666, from commercialinstallations.com) found no license held by this Raleigh company. The only near match is L.70351, 'Commercial Installation & Construction Company' of Saint Louis, MO. It is a different business, with status Archived and License Not Valid, expired 12/31/2021. The company site (https://www.commercialinstallations.com/) lists Raleigh, NC as its only location and toilet partitions among its Division 10 installs. The site shows no license number. North Carolina requires a GC license only above the state threshold ($40,000 per project), so not holding one does not by itself mean the company is out of compliance on smaller partition jobs. City of Raleigh: we found no online city contractor registry to search, and the local rule is a low-confidence item to confirm by phone with Raleigh Development Services.
